stories.title: Buying used CPUs can expose users to existing bans from anti-cheat engines, and there's no way to check for violations before purchase

sources.title: Buying used CPUs can expose users to existing bans from anti-cheat engines, and there's no way to check for violations before purchase
sources.title_en: Buying used CPUs can expose users to existing bans from anti-cheat engines, and there's no way to check for violations before purchase
sources.title_original: Buying used CPUs can expose users to existing bans from anti-cheat engines, and there's no way to check for violations before purchase
sources.summary: The CPU's previous owner apparently used it for cheating on Valorant, with its HWID getting flagged by Vanguard. When the Redditor bought and installed it on their PC, their Valorant account received a ban, too.
sources.summary_zh: 该 CPU 的前任所有者显然用它来作弊《Valorant》，其 HWID 被 Vanguard 标记。当 Reddit 用户购买并将其安装在他们的电脑上时，他们的 Valorant 帐户也受到了禁令。
